title: The River Cuts Its Own Corner
summary: A bend erodes its outside and builds its inside, so it deepens and crawls downstream until two limbs touch and the loop is left behind as a lake. Scrub three centuries of it.

sources.title: Ikeda, Parker & Sawai, Bend theory of river meanders (JFM, 1981)
Howard & Knutson, Sufficient conditions for river meandering (WRR, 1984)
